description: This file is a PHP script for the edit view of the 'Potentials' module in a vtiger CRM system. It initializes the entity, loads required modules, manages request parameters, prepares data for rendering the Smarty templates for editing or creating a potential record, and handles form display logic.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class managing CRM entities, responsible for retrieving and manipulating module data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine extension customized for vtiger CRM, used for rendering views.
